Hey everyone,

We are excited to announce 📢 that a major patch has just been released! We've worked hard to include as many of your requests as possible. Enjoy the new updates🎈

✔️ New: Rapid Company Mode – A setting that makes company sales much easier, ideal for faster business progress.

✔️ Normal Company Mode Fine-Tune – Slightly improved progression balance in normal difficulty.
✔️ Global Cloth Unlock – If one of your characters receives an item from a completely new clothing collection, that collection will be opened to all your characters from now. (So you can unlock cloth pieces from that collection for everyone with your Cloth Tokens from that point)
✔️ Compact Passes – Shortened passes for quicker progression and faster access to special rewards.

notes.title: Important Update: Release Date
notes.notes:
We've got an important update for our upcoming game! Due to the nature of our game's content, we've had to adjust our release date to 10/24 to accommodate Steam's review process. We genuinely appreciate your patience and support!
During this extra time, we'll be taking the opportunity to polish the game even further. Thank you for understanding, and we can't wait to share our enhanced game with you on 10/24!
